text:
Ana: quick brainstorm  I want to propose a tiered ramp private-offer that combines a short-term implementation credit (for SI) + a hardware voucher (for infra partners) while keeping total subsidy capped. goal: reduce friction for first 90 days and improve renewal rates.
Diego: high level sounds good. can you sketch concrete numbers? sales needs it to model ARR impact.
Ana: rough sketch: 3-month ramp: month1 credit = 30% of invoice (implementation + voucher split), month2 = 15%, month3 = 5%. on renewal, if usage >= 85% of projected commit -> one-time renewal credit of $10k applied to year 2.
Priya: who gets invoiced for SI credits? partner or us? how do we prevent double-dipping with marketplace promo credits?
Connor: prefer partner invoices us for SI credits and hardware vouchers; we pay net-of-performance after audit. add stacking rule: marketplace vendor credits can apply but total external + us <= 45% of list price.
Rina: legal note  need SOW + acceptance criteria for SI credits. also need data sharing clause so we can verify usage before remitting funds.
FinanceBot: flagged: add internal ROI gate: expected LTV >= 10x total subsidy. system will mark deals that fail gate for finance approval.
Tariq: operational question: how to represent this on the marketplace SKU? add an "Offer Addendum" line that references the private-offer id. marketplace APIs usually allow 1 ad-hoc credit line per order.
Ana: yes, plan: private-offer metadata contains: subsidy schedule, partner payee id, audit window (90d), stacking-cap. we'll codify with a template.
Diego: can we have a simple sample calc for sales? e.g., customer A commit = $120k ARR, projected first 3 months bill = $30k, subsidy schedule -> we pay 30% of month1 ($9k), 15% of month2 ($4.5k), 5% of month3 ($1.5k) = $15k total. renewal credit if usage >= floor -> $10k year-2 credit. net cost Y1 = $25k.
Priya: add a clawback: if customer churns before 6 months, partner reimburses 50% of SI credit paid. that should deter low-quality signups.
Connor: agree. also need a partner eligibility list: only approved SI+HW partners with signed reseller addendum get voucher stacking.
Rina: timeline: I can draft the addendum and clawback language in 5 business days.
FinanceBot: also recommend tagging each private-offer with a revenue reserve code so GAAP recognition is clean. ops to map reserve code per offer id.
Ana: metrics to track in pilot: weekly active customers on subsidized offers, subsidy burn rate, MRR uplift at renewal, partner earned credits, and number of audits triggered.
Diego: pilot cohort suggestion: 6 offers across 2 cloud marketplaces + 1 appliance partner + 2 SI-led deals. run 90 days.
Priya: for automation: we can use marketplace webhooks for order events + partner-submitted reconciliation file (CSV weekly). we should standardize CSV columns: private_offer_id, customer_id, usage_units, billed_amount, partner_claim_amount.
Tariq: sample CSV header:
```
private_offer_id,customer_id,month,usage_tokens,billed_amount_usd,partner_claim_usd,partner_id
PO-2026-0001,CUST-889,2026-05,310000,12000,3600,PART-77
```
Priya: perfect. add checksum + signed-file requirement for partner claims.
Connor: one more: UI/quote flow for sales: show "expected net bill" with subsidy applied and show renewal credit as contingent line item. we should be explicit about contingent vs billed credits.
Ana: logistics: volunteers? @Priya will own partner reconciliation spec, @Rina legal, @Diego pilot design & metrics, @Tariq marketplace integration, @Connor finance ops.
Priya: in. will draft CSV spec by Fri.
Rina: legal will draft addendum and clawback by next Wed.
Diego: will set up pilot cohort and meeting with partners.
Tariq: will map API capabilities for 3 marketplaces and confirm if ad-hoc credit line is supported.
Ana: cool. next actions: I'll assemble a runbook + put the draft offer template in the shared doc. link: https://tinyurl.com/mp-tiered-ramp. aim to kick pilot in 5 weeks. :calendar:
FinanceBot: FYI created finance code: RES-PILOT-0426 for tracking.
Ana: thanks all, we'll iterate. :rocket:
